location: Dun Morogh, below the Train Depot
entrance: The front gate in the Train Depot in western Dun Morogh, at /way 17.7 39.2. The back door on the north side needs the Workshop Key or a Rogue with Lockpicking 150.

2922.objective: Kill Techbot and bring his Memory Core to Tinkmaster Overspark.
2922.note: Techbot stands in the Loading Room of the Train Depot, outside the instance.

2930.objective: Turn a White Punch Card into a Prismatic Punch Card at the four Matrix Punchograph 3005 machines and bring it to Master Mechanic Castpipe.
2930.note: Machine A stands outside near Techbot. B is in the Dormitory, C in the room of Electrocutioner 6000 and D below Crowd Pummeler 9-60.

2924.objective: Collect 12 Essential Artificials from the machines spread through the dungeon.

2928.objective: Bring 24 Robo-mechanical Guts to Shoni the Shilent.
2928.note: Most mechanical monsters inside drop them.

2962.objective: Collect High Potency Radioactive Fallout from the irradiated monsters and bring it in the Heavy Leaden Collection Phial to Ozzie Togglevolt.
2962.note: The fallout collapses quickly, and the phial has to be back with Ozzie within 2 hours. It follows Gnogaine.

2929.objective: Kill Mekgineer Thermaplugg and report to High Tinker Mekkatorque.

2841.objective: Bring the Rig Blueprints and Thermaplugg's Safe Combination to Nogg.
2841.note: Thermaplugg drops the combination, and the blueprints lie in his safe. Sovik next to Nogg has no exclamation mark: talk to him for Chief Engineer Scooty. Finish that one first through a party share without Rig Wars, and Nogg stops offering Rig Wars.

2904.objective: Escort Kernobee to the exit at the Clockwork Run and report to Scooty in Booty Bay.
2904.note: Kernobee stands in one of several spots in the Dormitory, just after the Clean Zone.

2951.objective: Put a Grime-Encrusted Object into The Sparklematic 5200. The machine needs 3 silver to start.
2951.note: Repeatable, with experience only the first time.

2945.objective: Clean the Grime-Encrusted Ring in The Sparklematic 5200.
2945.note: The ring drops from Dark Iron Agents. Return of the Ring then goes to Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge or Nogg in Orgrimmar.
